title: Console: Narrowed MVP for Inspectors (dashboards, tracing, cost breakdown)
creator: Evan Zhang
description: Context: During scope review for the Console Observability initiative we identified time and implementation risk from 4 large surface areas: full-card dashboard library, end-to-end tracing (span visualizations + flamegraphs), per-token cost attribution, and multi-tenant cross-model aggregation. Goal: reduce scope to a narrowly defined MVP that delivers immediate operational value and aligns with runtime and backend delivery constraints.
problem_statement: Teams expect quick actionable visibility into latency, errors, and spend without a large upfront engineering cost. The original scope contained many deep features that push infra and design timelines >2 cycles. We need a prioritized cut that preserves core user journeys (SRE triage, cost regression detection, model-level cost attribution) while deferring lower-value surface area.
proposal_summary: Deliver a minimal 'Inspectors' surface with three dashboard widgets (Request Rate, Latency P50/P95, Model Spend by Route), a lightweight request tracing link that surfaces request id -> logs + timeline (no flamegraphs or full-span waterfall), and a coarse-grained cost breakdown (by model and route, daily granularity). Defer: per-token cost attribution, full trace flamegraph UI, live session replay, and ad-hoc dashboard editor in this release.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards: Three out-of-the-box widgets available on tenant /org/:id/inspectors: Request Rate (1m/5m), Latency (P50/P95) with histogram summary, Model Spend by Route (daily totals, top 10 routes).
Dashboards: Widgets must load within 500ms for tenants with <= 1000 req/min using the telemetry query API. Backend queries should have documented query plans and fallbacks.

Tracing: Every request in the console links to a minimal trace page showing request id, timestamp, route, model variant, and timeline of key events (ingress -> runtime -> egress). No span flamegraphs required.
Tracing: Link to logs and GitHub PR (if present) for correlated debugging. Tracing page must render for sample traces (1k traces/day) within 1s for the common case.
Cost Breakdown: Daily aggregated spend grouped by {model, route} for the last 30 days. Values must match billing export within 1% for sampled tenants. No per-token line items in UI for MVP.
Security: UI respects RBAC and does not expose tenant data cross-org. Console feature flag must default off for private deploy customers unless enabled.
Docs: PRD + short runbook + acceptance playbook (steps to validate metrics, sampling tests) checked into the docs repo and linked from the ticket.
decisions: Cut per-token attribution (deferred to next major iteration) due to high telemetry cardinality and backend indexing cost.
Implement a sampling strategy for traces (1% by default, configurable per-tenant) to limit storage and UI load.
Expose a single cost aggregation pivot (model x route) instead of ad-hoc group-bys to reduce backend query permutations.
Prioritize dashboard load perf (<=500ms) over customizable dashboard composition for MVP.
tradeoffs: Users lose fine-grained per-token spend insight at launch, which makes micro-optimizations harder until later iterations.
Minimal trace UI means deeper span-level latency breakdowns are unavailable; SREs will rely on linked logs and runtime dashboards initially.
Sampling traces reduces fidelity for rare incidents but keeps storage and UI latency within acceptable bounds.
implementation_notes: Backend: Add daily aggregation job for (model, route) spend with retention 90d; expose via telemetry API endpoint /v1/telemetry/aggregates.
Runtime: Tag requests with trace_id and tenant metadata; inject link in request detail UI to minimal trace view.
Console UI: New /inspectors route with three widgets and a trace detail pane. Use existing card component (DES-1302) to speed delivery.
Observability: Add dashboard-level SLOs for widget render latency and telemetry API error rate.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Aggregation mismatch vs billing. Mitigation: Run reconciliation job and add alert if delta >1% on sample tenants before enabling globally.
Risk: UI performance regressions on large tenants. Mitigation: enforce query timeouts and fallback to cached snapshot view after 1s.
Risk: Customers request per-token breakdown. Mitigation: document roadmap and provide CSV export of raw billing data as interim solution.
